## What's free

Free plan: 5 users, 10 concurrent jobs, 2,000 hosted Linux vCPU-minutes/month, 30-day build retention, 250k test executions/month

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://buildkite.com/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Self-hosted agents can run on free VMs from the hybrid inventory.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
